svg.title: The share of GDP spent on research and development varies widely across countries
svg.desc: Bar chart: The share of GDP spent on research and development varies widely across countries: R&D spending: South Korea: 4.85%, United States: 3.49%, Sweden: 3.47%, Japan: 3.40%, Belgium: 3.20%, Austria: 3.18%, Germany: 3.07%, Finland: 2.98%, Denmark: 2.87%, United Kingdom: 2.75%, Iceland: 2.60%, China: 2.49%, Türkiye: 1.32%, OECD members: 2.94%.
